goal: Keep valid, mineable transactions in the mempool instead of dropping them based purely on age
Avoid unnecessary transaction rebroadcasts and reduce per-transaction memory and indexing overhead
agreement: Unaddressed objection: test no longer checks parent is resubmitted before child, no reply (fametrano)
Document in release notes that abandontransaction now fails for transactions over two weeks old (fametrano)
Concern that removing expiry prevents operators or miners from reverting if harmful (ajtowns)
Concept approval because expiry assumptions are outdated and immediate cleanup is beneficial (stickies-v)
Concept approval without detailed reasons (maflcko, tumutech)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it stops evicting mineable transactions that otherwise trigger redundant network rebroadcasts
Eliminates entry-time index overhead, saving memory and tree updates on every transaction insert and delete
